items.title: 不定式作主语与形式主语
items.brief: 主语太长就后置，用 it 占位，谓语用单数

concept.summary: 判定标准：句子缺主语，而所填内容是具体一次或尚未发生的动作，用不定式作主语。单个不定式作主语时，谓语用单数，因为整个不定式结构被当作一个整体。主语过长时后移到句末，用 it 占据主语位置，形成形式主语结构，真正的主语仍在句末。

sections.h: 直接作主语：谓语用单数
sections.p: 不定式短语在句中充当一个名词性整体，即使短语内部带有复数名词，谓语也只与这个整体一致，用单数第三人称。
bullets: To master a language takes years of practice.
To say is one thing; to do is another.
To see is to believe.（主语与表语都是不定式）
To keep silent about it was the hardest part.

sections.h: 形式主语 it 的四个固定框
sections.p: 主语超过几个词时，英语习惯把它推到句末，用 it 占位。判断依据是句首的 it 没有实际所指，把它删掉句子仍成立。
bullets: It is + adj. + to do：It is hard to please everybody.
It takes sb. + 时间 + to do：It took me an hour to finish the test.
It is + n. + to do：It is a pleasure to work with you.
It is + adj. + for/of sb. + to do：It is important for you to rest.

sections.h: for sb. 与 of sb. 的判定
sections.p: 形容词描述这件事的性质，逻辑主语前用 for；形容词描述人的品质或性格，用 of。检验方法是把 sb. 提到句首作主语，句子仍成立就用 of。
bullets: It is difficult for me to decide. → 不能说 I am difficult，用 for
It is generous of him to share his notes. → He is generous 成立，用 of
of 的常用词：kind, generous, clever, careless, rude, silly, brave

examples.en: To master a foreign language takes years of practice.
examples.zh: 掌握一门外语需要多年的练习。
examples.note: 不定式作主语，指向一件具体的事，谓语用单数 takes。

examples.en: It is difficult for beginners to tell the two words apart.
examples.zh: 初学者很难分辨这两个词。
examples.note: it 是形式主语，真正主语 to tell... 后置；difficult 说明事情的性质，用 for。

examples.en: It was careless of him to leave the door unlocked.
examples.zh: 他没锁门就走了，真粗心。
examples.note: careless 评价人的品质，He was careless 成立，因此用 of。

examples.en: To see is to believe.
examples.zh: 眼见为实。
examples.note: 主语与表语都用不定式，主语视为整体，谓语用 is。

examples.en: It is important of you to keep your promise.
examples.zh: 你遵守诺言很重要。
examples.note: important 说明事情的重要程度，不评价人的品质，应改为 for you。

examples.en: Learn a foreign language takes years of practice.
examples.zh: 学一门外语需要多年的练习。
examples.note: 动词原形不能作主语，应改为 To learn 或 Learning。

pitfalls.wrong: It is hard of me to concentrate in this noise.
pitfalls.right: It is hard for me to concentrate in this noise.
pitfalls.why: hard 描述的是集中注意力这件事的难度，不是我的品质，逻辑主语前用 for；of 只用于 kind、generous、careless 这类评价人的形容词。

pitfalls.wrong: Read English aloud every morning is helpful.
pitfalls.right: Reading English aloud every morning is helpful.
pitfalls.why: 主语位置必须由名词性成分占据，动词原形是祈使句形式，不能作主语，须名词化为动名词或不定式。

pitfalls.wrong: To finishing the task in a week is impossible.
pitfalls.right: To finish the task in a week is impossible.
pitfalls.why: 此处的 to 是不定式符号，后面必须接动词原形；只有 to 作介词时才接动名词，如 look forward to finishing。

contrast.diff: 不定式作主语多指具体一次或尚未发生的动作，动名词作主语多指一般性习惯或已知事实；两者谓语都用单数。

concept.mnemonic: 主语太长往后放，it 先占位；for 说事难，of 说人差。

core: 缺主语且动作具体或未发生 → 用不定式作主语
单个不定式作主语，谓语用单数
主语过长时用 it 作形式主语，真正主语后置
It takes sb. time to do 中的 it 也是形式主语
形容词评事用 for sb.，评人用 of sb.
review.trigger: 句首缺主语又想放一个动词 → 加 to 名词化 → 太长就把 it 提到句首

quickCheck.q: To master a language ___ (take) years. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: takes，不定式作主语视为单数。

quickCheck.q: It is kind ___ you to help. 填 for 还是 of？
quickCheck.a: of，kind 评价人的品质，You are kind 成立。

quickCheck.q: 主语是 Learn English 行不行？
quickCheck.a: 不行，动词原形不能作主语，须改为 Learning 或 To learn。

drills.stem: ___ a decision without all the facts would be unwise.
drills.answer: To make
drills.explain: 句首缺主语，空格后是宾语 a decision，需要一个能带宾语的名词性成分。make 与逻辑主语是主动关系，且尚未发生，用不定式 To make 作主语，谓语用单数 would be。
drills.trap: Make 是祈使句的动词原形，没有名词性，不能占据主语位置；Made 是过去分词，会把 make 说成被动。

drills.stem: It took the workers three weeks ___ (repair) the bridge.
drills.answer: to repair
drills.hint: It took sb. + 时间 + ___ 是形式主语结构。
drills.explain: 先看成分：It 只是形式主语，真正的主语内容后置在空格处，缺主语。再看关系：repair 由 the workers 主动发出。最后看时间：修桥就是 took 所计量的那段时间，与谓语无先后差。故用一般式不定式 to repair。

drills.stem: It was generous ___ you to pay for everyone's lunch.
drills.answer: of
drills.explain: generous 评价的是人的品质，把 you 提到句首说 You were generous 完全成立，因此逻辑主语前用 of。
drills.trap: for 用于 difficult、important、necessary 这类描述事情性质的形容词，与 generous 的评价对象不同。

drills.stem: It takes me half an hour to walking to the station.
drills.answer: It takes me half an hour to walk to the station.
accept: It takes me half an hour to walk to the station.
drills.explain: It takes sb. + 时间 + to do 中的 to 是不定式符号，后面必须接动词原形，不能用动名词 walking。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It is not easy to change a habit overnight.
drills.explain: it 是形式主语，真正主语 to change a habit overnight 后置；不定式作主语整体视为单数，谓语用 is。

drills.stem: 对孩子们来说，在这么冷的天气里早起是很难的。
drills.answer: It is hard for children to get up early in such cold weather.
drills.explain: 主语是 to get up early 这个长不定式，后置后用 it 占位。hard 描述事情难度而非孩子的品质，逻辑主语前用 for；若用 of 就等于说孩子本身很难。

items.title: 不定式作宾语与宾补
items.brief: 宾语看动词，宾补看宾语，省 to 只在特定动词后

concept.summary: 判定标准：谓语动词后没有宾语，而所缺内容是一个尚未发生的动作，用不定式作宾语；谓语后已有宾语但还需补足宾语做什么，用不定式作宾补，此时宾语就是不定式的逻辑主语。宾补位置的不定式与宾语构成主谓关系，改成被动后宾语升为主语，省去的 to 必须还原。

sections.h: 作宾语：形式由动词锁定
sections.p: 这类动词的宾语只能是不定式，换动名词就错。按语义分组记比逐词背更稳。
bullets: 意愿与决定：decide, choose, plan, intend, refuse, agree, promise
期望与努力：hope, wish, expect, manage, afford, fail, learn
判断与巧合：pretend, seem, appear, happen
疑问词 + 不定式：I don't know what to do. / He taught me how to swim.

sections.h: 作宾补：宾语是逻辑主语
sections.p: 谓语后已有宾语，动词还需要说明宾语将做什么时，用不定式作宾补。判断依据是宾语与不定式能构成主谓关系：They forced him to sign 就是 He signs。
bullets: ask / tell / want / invite / encourage / remind / warn sb. to do
allow / permit / forbid / force / order / teach sb. to do
We expect the plan to work.（the plan works）
They forced him to sign. → He was forced to sign.

sections.h: 省 to 的宾补与形式宾语
sections.p: 感官动词与使役动词后的宾补省略 to，因为它们表示动作的完整过程；改成被动语态时 to 必须回来。think、find、consider、make 后接宾补时，常用 it 作形式宾语，把不定式推到句末。
bullets: 感官：see, hear, watch, notice, feel, observe + sb. + do
使役：make, let, have + sb. + do
I saw him cross the street. → He was seen to cross the street.
I find it hard to get up early.（it 为形式宾语）

examples.en: She refused to accept the offer.
examples.zh: 她拒绝接受这个提议。
examples.note: refuse 后缺宾语，只能由不定式承担。

examples.en: They encouraged the students to ask questions.
examples.zh: 他们鼓励学生提问。
examples.note: students 是宾语，to ask 是宾补，提问由学生发出。

examples.en: I saw him enter the building through the side door.
examples.zh: 我看见他从侧门进了大楼。
examples.note: 感官动词 see 后的宾补省略 to，表示看见整个动作。

examples.en: He was seen to enter the building through the side door.
examples.zh: 有人看见他从侧门进了大楼。
examples.note: 改成被动后宾语升为主语，省略的 to 必须还原。

examples.en: I don't know how to solve this problem.
examples.zh: 我不知道怎样解决这个问题。
examples.note: 疑问词 how 后接不定式，整体作 know 的宾语。

examples.en: She suggested to postpone the meeting.
examples.zh: 她建议推迟会议。
examples.note: suggest 的宾语只接受动名词或 that 从句，应改为 suggested postponing。

examples.en: He made me to wait for two hours.
examples.zh: 他让我等了两个小时。
examples.note: 使役动词 make 后的宾补省略 to，应改为 made me wait。

pitfalls.wrong: He made me to clean the whole classroom.
pitfalls.right: He made me clean the whole classroom.
pitfalls.why: make 是使役动词，宾补不定式省略 to；只有在被动语态中 to 才还原，说 I was made to clean。

pitfalls.wrong: She suggested to change the plan.
pitfalls.why: suggest 的宾语位置只接受动名词或 that 从句，不定式不能充当它的宾语，这不是语义问题而是动词的搭配限制。

pitfalls.wrong: The children were made clean the classroom.
pitfalls.right: The children were made to clean the classroom.
pitfalls.why: 主动句省略的 to 在被动句中必须还原，因为原来的宾语成了主语，宾补结构变成了主语补足语。

contrast.withTitle: 只接动名词的动词与短语
contrast.diff: 两组的宾语形式都由动词锁定：decide、hope、refuse 接不定式，suggest、enjoy、avoid 接动名词，判断时先认动词再定形式。

concept.mnemonic: decide、hope、refuse 后接 to do；see、make、let 后省 to，变被动再还回来。

core: 宾语位置的形式由动词决定：decide/hope/refuse/promise 接 to do
宾补位置的不定式与宾语构成主谓关系：ask sb. to do
感官与使役动词后省 to：see/make/let sb. do
变被动时省去的 to 必须还原：was made to do
疑问词 + 不定式可作宾语：how to solve it
review.trigger: 谓语后没有宾语 → 接 to do；谓语后已有宾语还要补动作 → to do 作宾补

quickCheck.q: suggest 后面能接 to do 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，只能接动名词或 that 从句。

quickCheck.q: He was made ___ (clean) the room. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: to clean，被动句中 to 必须还原。

quickCheck.q: I find it hard ___ (get) up early. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: to get，it 是形式宾语，真正宾语后置。

drills.stem: She finally agreed ___ the terms of the contract.
drills.answer: to accept
drills.explain: agreed 后缺宾语，所缺内容是尚未发生的动作，agree 的宾语只能由不定式或 that 从句承担。
drills.trap: accepting 是把 agree 误当成接动名词的动词；accept 是动词原形，不能直接作宾语。

drills.stem: The teacher warned us ___ (not touch) the wires.
drills.answer: not to touch
drills.hint: warn sb. 后的宾补，否定词放在 to 之前。
drills.explain: 先看成分：warned 后已有宾语 us，缺的是宾补。再看关系：touch 由 us 发出，是主动。最后看时间：碰电线是尚未发生、需要避免的动作。故用 to touch，否定词 not 置于 to 之前，得 not to touch。

drills.stem: The manager made the team ___ the proposal twice before the deadline.
drills.answer: revise
drills.explain: made 后已有宾语 the team，缺宾补。make 是使役动词，宾补不定式省略 to，直接用动词原形 revise。
drills.trap: to revise 是受不定式等于 to do 的一般印象支配，忽略了使役动词必须省 to 这一条。

drills.stem: He was seen enter the building through the back door.
drills.answer: He was seen to enter the building through the back door.
accept: He was seen to enter the building through the back door.
drills.explain: 主动句 We saw him enter 中宾补省 to，改成被动后 him 升为主语，原来的宾补变成主语补足语，省去的 to 必须还原。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: I don't know how to explain this to my parents.
drills.explain: know 后缺宾语，疑问词 how 与不定式 to explain 结合成一个名词性结构作宾语，explain 由 I 主动发出。

drills.stem: 他答应帮我在周五前完成报告。
drills.answer: He promised to help me finish the report by Friday.
drills.explain: promise 后缺宾语，其宾语只能是不定式 to help。help sb. (to) do 中宾补的 to 可以省略，故用 help me finish；promise 不能接 sb. to do 的宾补结构。

items.title: 不定式作定语
items.brief: 名词后表将来，不及物动词别丢介词

concept.summary: 判定标准：名词后缺修饰语，且这个修饰语表示该名词将要承受或发出的动作，用不定式作后置定语。不定式与被修饰名词之间只有三种关系：主谓、动宾、同位。不及物动词作定语时必须保留它所需的介词，介词的宾语就是被修饰的名词。

sections.p: 判断关系的方法是把这个名词放回不定式后面，看它当主语还是当宾语。当主语是主谓关系，当宾语是动宾关系，抽象名词后说明内容则是同位关系。
bullets: 主谓：She was the first woman to win the prize.（the woman wins）
动宾：I still have several letters to write.（write the letters）
同位：the ability to concentrate / a chance to travel / the decision to resign
the first / last / only / best + 名词 + to do 是高频框

sections.p: 不及物动词或需要介词才能带宾语的动作，作定语时介词必须留在不定式末尾，作用是把被修饰名词接回来。这与定语从句省略关系代词后保留介词同理。
bullets: a pen to write with / a chair to sit on
a house to live in / a flat to share with a friend
nothing to worry about / nobody to talk to
× a pen to write（write 缺宾语，pen 接不上）

sections.p: 被修饰名词是动作的承受者、且句子主语无法承担这个动作时，用被动不定式。need、want、require 表需要时尤其常见，也可换用动名词主动形式表被动。
bullets: There is a lot of work to be done.
The house needs to be repaired.（= needs repairing）
The meeting to be held tomorrow has been postponed.
× The house needs to repair.

examples.en: She was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize in physics.
examples.zh: 她是第一位获得诺贝尔物理学奖的女性。
examples.note: 序数词 + 名词后接不定式作定语，woman 与 win 是主谓关系。

examples.en: I still have several letters to write before Friday.
examples.zh: 周五之前我还有几封信要写。
examples.note: letters 是 write 的宾语，动宾关系，动作尚未发生用 to write。

examples.en: He is looking for a room to live in near the campus.
examples.zh: 他正在找校园附近的一间住房。
examples.note: live 是不及物动词，介词 in 保留在末尾，把 room 接回来。

examples.en: There is nothing to worry about.
examples.zh: 没有什么可担心的。
examples.note: worry 需借助 about 才能与 nothing 建立动宾关系。

examples.en: He was the last man to tell a lie.
examples.zh: 他是最不可能撒谎的人。
examples.note: last 后接不定式作定语，表示最不会做该动作的人。

examples.en: She has a lot of friends to play.
examples.zh: 她有很多可以一起玩的朋友。
examples.note: play 需带介词 with 才能接 friends，应改为 to play with。

examples.en: This is a good book to reading.
examples.zh: 这是一本值得读的好书。
examples.note: to 在此是不定式符号，后接动词原形，应改为 to read。

pitfalls.wrong: He needs a pen to write.
pitfalls.right: He needs a pen to write with.
pitfalls.why: write 在这里要带宾语 pen，必须借介词 with；介词不出现，pen 与 write 的动宾关系就断掉了。

pitfalls.wrong: She is the first student to winning the contest.
pitfalls.right: She is the first student to win the contest.
pitfalls.why: the first + 名词后的定语用不定式，to 是不定式符号，后面只能接动词原形。

pitfalls.wrong: The house needs to repair before winter.
pitfalls.right: The house needs to be repaired before winter.
pitfalls.why: need 表需要时，主语 house 是 repair 的承受者，不定式要用被动式；也可改用 needs repairing。

contrast.diff: 作定语时不定式紧跟名词、说明这个名词要做什么；作状语时不修饰名词，而是修饰整个谓语，说明目的或结果。

concept.mnemonic: 名词后面 to do 指将来；不及物动词别丢介词，受动就加 be done。

core: 名词后表将来或应做的动作 → 不定式作后置定语
三种关系：主谓、动宾、同位（ability to do）
不及物动词作定语必须保留介词：a pen to write with
the first / last / only + 名词 + to do 为高频结构
被修饰名词是受动者时用 to be done：work to be done
review.trigger: 名词后面缺修饰 → 把这个名词放回动词后试位置 → 缺介词就补介词

quickCheck.a: a pen to write with，with 不能省。
to be repaired 或 repairing，房子是被修的。

quickCheck.q: the first person 后面接 to do 还是 doing？
quickCheck.a: to do，the first/last/only 后接不定式作定语。

drills.stem: She is the only person ___ the truth about that night.
drills.answer: to know
drills.explain: the only + 名词后缺定语，用不定式。she 与 know 是主谓关系，她是知道真相的人，主动，故用 to know。
drills.trap: to be known 表被动，等于说她是被知道的对象，与她掌握真相的语义相反；known 单独作定语也无法表达唯一性。

drills.stem: He is looking for a flat ___ (live) in near the campus.
drills.answer: to live
drills.hint: flat 是被住的对象，live 后已有介词 in。
drills.explain: 先看成分：flat 后缺定语。再看关系：live 是不及物动词，flat 是住的地点而非施动者，属动宾关系。最后看时间：找房是为了将来住，用不定式。故填 to live，介词 in 已留在句中。

drills.stem: There is nothing ___ about; the machine is working perfectly.
drills.answer: to worry about
drills.explain: nothing 后缺定语，worry 在此为不及物动词，必须借 about 才能与 nothing 构成动宾关系，故为 nothing to worry about。
drills.trap: to worry 丢掉介词后，nothing 无法充当 worry 的宾语，动宾关系不成立。

drills.stem: The meeting to hold tomorrow has been postponed.
drills.answer: The meeting to be held tomorrow has been postponed.
accept: The meeting to be held tomorrow has been postponed.
drills.explain: meeting 后缺定语，meeting 是 hold 的承受者，且会议尚未召开，受动加将来用被动不定式 to be held；hold 是及物动词，不能写成 to hold 却留着宾语空位。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He was the first person to arrive at the scene.
drills.explain: the first + 名词后用不定式作定语，person 与 arrive 是主谓关系，动作相对于 was 尚未发生。

drills.stem: 她是最早到达现场的人之一。
drills.answer: She was one of the first people to arrive at the scene.
drills.explain: people 后缺定语，the first 限定的名词后用不定式；arrive 与 people 是主谓关系，动作由人主动发出，故用 to arrive。

items.title: 不定式作状语
items.brief: 只表目的、结果、原因，不表时间条件

concept.summary: 判定标准：句子主谓宾已经完整，缺的是说明为什么做、做到什么结果、为什么产生某种情绪的状语，用不定式。不定式作状语只承担三种意义：目的、结果、原因。表目的时可用 in order to 或 so as to 强化，其中 so as to 不能置于句首；表结果时常用 only to 引出意外结果。

sections.p: 不定式的逻辑主语就是句子主语，动作在谓语之后发生。若是否定目的，not 放在 to 之前。判断依据是能改写为 in order that 从句。
bullets: She got up early to catch the first bus.
In order not to wake the baby, he closed the door quietly.
so as to 只能放句中：He left early so as to avoid the traffic.
× So as to save time, we took a taxi.

sections.p: 结果状语的不定式表示谓语动作带来的结局，常与 only、never、too...to、enough to 搭配。only to 专指出乎意料、令人失望的结果。
bullets: He hurried to the station, only to find the train had left.
She is old enough to make her own decisions.
He was too tired to walk any further.
He lifted the rock, only to drop it at once.

sections.p: 在 glad、sorry、sad、surprised、happy、pleased、angry、relieved 等表示情绪反应的形容词后，不定式说明产生这种情绪的原因，可改写为 because 从句。
bullets: I am glad to hear from you.
She was surprised to find the door open.
We are sorry to keep you waiting.
He was relieved to learn that everyone was safe.

examples.en: He saved every penny to buy his mother a house.
examples.zh: 他省下每一分钱，为的是给母亲买一套房。
examples.note: 目的状语，可改写为 in order that he could buy。

examples.en: In order not to miss the flight, they left at dawn.
examples.zh: 为了不错过航班，他们天亮就出发了。
examples.note: 否定目的用 in order not to，可置于句首。

examples.en: She opened the box, only to find it empty.
examples.zh: 她打开盒子，结果发现是空的。
examples.note: only to 引出意外结果，动作发生在 opened 之后。

examples.en: I was relieved to hear that everyone was safe.
examples.zh: 听说大家都平安，我松了一口气。
examples.note: 情绪形容词 relieved 后的不定式说明原因。

examples.en: He is too young to drive a car.
examples.zh: 他太小了，不能开车。
examples.note: too + 形容词 + to do 表否定结果，句子本身不含 not。

examples.en: So as to catch the train, he ran all the way.
examples.zh: 为了赶上火车，他一路跑过去。
examples.note: so as to 不能置于句首，应改为 In order to catch the train。

examples.en: She studied hard for passing the exam.
examples.zh: 她努力学习以求通过考试。
examples.note: for + 动名词表用途，不表目的，应改为 to pass the exam。

pitfalls.wrong: So as to save time, we took a taxi.
pitfalls.right: In order to save time, we took a taxi.
pitfalls.why: so as to 只能出现在句子中间，句首表目的必须用 in order to 或直接用 to。

pitfalls.wrong: He ran fast for catching the bus.
pitfalls.right: He ran fast to catch the bus.
pitfalls.why: for + 动名词说明用途或功能，不表达目的；目的状语只能由不定式承担。

pitfalls.wrong: She is enough old to vote.
pitfalls.right: She is old enough to vote.
pitfalls.why: enough 修饰形容词时必须后置，构成 adj. + enough to do；前置的 enough 只能修饰名词。

contrast.diff: 作状语时不定式修饰谓语，逻辑主语是句子主语；作定语时修饰前面的名词，名词才是它的主语或宾语。

concept.mnemonic: 目的、结果、原因三种用法；so as to 不进句首，enough 站在形容词后。

core: 不定式作状语只表目的、结果、原因，不表时间或条件
目的 ：to do / in order to do / so as to do，so as to 不放句首
结果：only to do（意外）、too...to、enough to
原因：情绪形容词后，glad/sorry/surprised + to do
否定目的把 not 放在 to 前：in order not to
review.trigger: 主谓宾齐全还缺一个为什么 → 先试目的 to do → 再看是否 only to 表意外结果

quickCheck.q: so as to 能放句首吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，句首用 in order to 或 to。

quickCheck.q: He is too tired to walk. 有否定含义吗？
quickCheck.a: 有，too...to 结构本身表否定结果，不能再加 not。

quickCheck.q: I am glad to hear it 中的 to hear 是什么状语？
quickCheck.a: 原因状语，说明为什么高兴。

drills.stem: He rushed to the airport, only ___ that his flight had been cancelled.
drills.answer: to find
drills.explain: 主谓 he rushed 已完整，缺的是结果状语。only to 是表示意外结果的固定组合，find 由 he 发出且发生在 rushed 之后，用 to find。
drills.trap: finding 表伴随，无法表达结果出乎意料这层意思；only 后不能接现在分词。

drills.stem: ___ (avoid) the morning traffic, she leaves home before seven.
drills.answer: To avoid
drills.explain: 先看成分：主谓 she leaves 完整，句首缺目的状语。再看关系：avoid 由 she 主动发出。最后看时间：避开高峰发生在出门之前的目的上，属谓语之后的意图。故用 To avoid，也可用 In order to avoid。

drills.stem: The box was ___ heavy for me to carry upstairs.
drills.answer: too
drills.explain: too + 形容词 + for sb. + to do 表示太……以至于不能，本身含否定结果，与句意盒子搬不上去吻合。
drills.trap: so 必须与 that 从句配套，不能直接接 to do；very 只能表示程度，构不成结果结构。

drills.stem: She was enough lucky to get the last ticket.
drills.answer: She was lucky enough to get the last ticket.
accept: She was lucky enough to get the last ticket.
drills.explain: enough 修饰形容词时必须后置，构成 adj. + enough + to do；前置的 enough 只能修饰名词，如 enough money。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He got up early to catch the first bus.
drills.explain: 主谓 he got up early 已完整，to catch 是目的状语，由 he 主动发出，动作在 got up 之后。

drills.stem: 为了不吵醒孩子，他轻轻地关上了门。
drills.answer: He closed the door quietly so as not to wake the child.
drills.explain: 主谓 he closed 完整，缺目的状语，且是否定目的，not 必须放在 to 之前。so as not to 只能放句中，与这里的位置吻合；for + 动名词不表目的。

items.title: 不定式的时态与语态
items.brief: 先于谓语用 have done，受动用 be done

concept.summary: 判定分两步：先比较不定式的动作与谓语的时间先后，同时或之后用 to do，先于谓语用 to have done；再看不定式的逻辑主语是施动还是受动，受动用 to be done，先于谓语且受动用 to have been done。不定式的时态是相对时态，参照点是句子的谓语，不是说话时间。

sections.p: 四种形式由两组参数组合而成：时间（一般或完成）与语态（主动或被动）。先定时间再定语态，顺序颠倒容易漏掉被动。
bullets: to do：与谓语同时或之后发生
to be doing：与谓语同时进行
to have done：先于谓语完成
to be done / to have been done：逻辑主语是受动者

sections.p: seem、appear、happen、be said、be believed、be reported 后的不定式最容易考时间先后，因为谓语本身只是一个评价或传闻，真正的信息全在不定式里。
bullets: He seems to have forgotten our appointment.（忘记在先）
She is said to be working on a new project.（此刻进行）
The manuscript is believed to have been written in the 1400s.（更早且被动）
He happened to be at home when I called.（同时）

sections.p: 看不定式前面的名词是不是动作的承受者：There is much work to be done 中 work 是被做的，所以用被动。注意 to let 没有被动不定式，通常换成 to be allowed。
bullets: There is still much work to be done.
The results are expected to be announced tomorrow.
She is easy to please.（主语是 please 的宾语，仍用主动形式）
He asked to be excused from the meeting.

examples.en: He seems to have forgotten our appointment.
examples.zh: 他似乎忘了我们的约定。
examples.note: 忘记先于 seems，用完成式 to have forgotten。

examples.en: She is said to be working on a new project.
examples.zh: 据说她正在做一个新项目。
examples.note: 进行式 to be working 表示与谓语同时进行。

examples.en: The manuscript is believed to have been written in the 1400s.
examples.zh: 据信这份手稿写于十五世纪。
examples.note: 先于谓语（完成）且手稿是被写的（被动），两条件叠加用 to have been written。

examples.en: There is still much work to be done.
examples.zh: 还有很多工作要做。
examples.note: work 是 do 的承受者，用被动不定式 to be done。

examples.en: He is happy to have finished the report before the deadline.
examples.zh: 他很高兴在截止日期前完成了报告。
examples.note: 完成先于 is happy，用完成式。

examples.en: He seems to forget our appointment yesterday.
examples.zh: 他似乎忘了我们昨天的约定。
examples.note: yesterday 说明忘记发生在 seems 之前，应改为 to have forgotten。

examples.en: The bridge is said to build in 1900.
examples.zh: 据说这座桥建于 1900 年。
examples.note: 桥是 build 的承受者，且建造早于传闻，应改为 to have been built。

pitfalls.wrong: She is said to write three novels so far.
pitfalls.right: She is said to have written three novels so far.
pitfalls.why: so far 与 is said 共同说明写作已完成且先于传闻，须用完成式 to have written；一般式会指向将来的写作。

pitfalls.wrong: The old temple is believed to be built in the Tang Dynasty.
pitfalls.right: The old temple is believed to have been built in the Tang Dynasty.
pitfalls.why: temple 是 build 的承受者（被动），且建造早于人们的相信（完成），两个条件叠加只能用 to have been done。

pitfalls.wrong: He happened to meet her before that day.
pitfalls.right: He happened to have met her before that day.
pitfalls.why: before that day 说明见面先于 happened，不定式要用完成式；一般式只能表示与 happened 同时或之后。

contrast.diff: 两者都用完成式表先于谓语、被动式表受动；区别在于不定式还有进行式 to be doing，且其参照点常在谓语之后，动名词的参照点常与谓语同时。

concept.mnemonic: 先对时间再对语态：先于谓语 have done，受动 be done，两样都要 have been done。

core: 不定式是相对时态，参照点是句子的谓语
同时或之后：to do；同时进行：to be doing；先于谓语：to have done
逻辑主语受动：to be done；先于谓语又受动：to have been done
seem / be said / be believed / happen 后最常考时间先后
There is work to be done 中 work 是被做的，必须用被动
review.trigger: 看到不定式先找谓语 → 问动作在前还是在后 → 再问主语是施动还是受动

quickCheck.q: He seems to have left. 中离开发生在什么时候？

quickCheck.a: to be done，work 是被做的。

quickCheck.q: 现在进行的不定式怎么写？
quickCheck.a: to be doing，如 is said to be working。

drills.stem: The castle is said ___ more than eight hundred years ago.
drills.answer: to have been built
drills.explain: 先看时间：eight hundred years ago 说明建造早于 is said，用完成式。再看语态：castle 是 build 的承受者，用被动。两者叠加即 to have been built。
drills.trap: to have built 是主动，等于说城堡建造了别的东西；to be built 无法体现动作早于传闻。

drills.stem: He seems ___ (lose) interest in the project since last spring.
drills.answer: to have lost
drills.hint: since last spring 说明失去兴趣已经发生。
drills.explain: 先看成分：seems 后缺表语性的不定式。再看关系：lose 由 he 主动发出。最后看时间：since last spring 表明失去兴趣先于 seems 并持续至今，用完成式 to have lost。

drills.stem: She is reported ___ on a new vaccine at the moment.
drills.answer: to be working
drills.explain: at the moment 指向与 is reported 同时的进行动作，不定式用进行式 to be working。work 由 she 主动发出，不需要被动。
drills.trap: to have been working 表动作持续到谓语之前，与 at the moment 指向的当前进行冲突。

drills.stem: She is said to finish the report already.
drills.answer: She is said to have finished the report already.
accept: She is said to have finished the report already.
drills.explain: already 说明完成报告先于 is said，不定式须用完成式 to have finished；一般式 to finish 只能指向将来的完成。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: There is still a great deal of work to be done.
drills.explain: work 是 do 的承受者，非谓语用被动式 to be done；谓语是 there be 结构中的 is，与 a great deal of work 一致。

drills.stem: 据说这座桥建于两百年前。
drills.answer: The bridge is said to have been built two hundred years ago.
drills.explain: 先看时间：两百年前说明建造早于 is said，用完成式。再看语态：bridge 是 build 的承受者，用被动。合并为 to have been built。

items.title: 不定式符号 to 的保留与省略
items.brief: 先分 to 是符号还是介词，再决定省不省

concept.summary: 判定第一步是给 to 定性：后面接动词原形的是不定式符号，接名词或动名词的是介词。符号 to 在感官动词与使役动词的宾补中必须省略，在被动语态中必须还原；在并列不定式、省略回答和固定结构中通常保留。介词 to 后面永远接动名词，不存在省略问题。

sections.h: 必须省 to 的两类动词
sections.p: 感官动词表示看到、听到动作的完整过程，使役动词表示让某人做某事，两类后面的宾补都省略 to。判断依据是主动句里 to 不出现，被动句里 to 出现。
bullets: 感官：see, hear, watch, notice, feel, observe + sb. + do
使役：make, let, have + sb. + do
I saw him leave. → He was seen to leave.
She made me wait. → I was made to wait.

sections.h: 保留 to 的三种情形
sections.p: 并列的两个不定式一般各自带 to，尤其表示对比时；省略回答中用 to 代替整个不定式，避免重复；固定结构中 to 已与前面的词粘成一体，不可省。
bullets: She told him to sit down and to wait.（并列对比，保留第二个 to）
I asked him to help, but he didn't want to.（to 代替 to help）
You don't have to come, but you ought to.
be going to / have to / used to 中的 to 不可省

sections.h: to 是介词的固定短语
sections.p: 这类短语中的 to 后面必须接名词或动名词，把它当不定式符号就会写错。识别方法是看 to 后面能不能放一个名词：能放就是介词。
bullets: look forward to doing / be used to doing / object to doing
devote oneself to doing / pay attention to doing / in addition to doing
I am used to getting up early.（习惯于）
I used to get up early.（过去常常，to 是符号）

examples.en: I saw him leave the office at six.
examples.zh: 我看见他六点离开办公室。
examples.note: 感官动词 see 后的宾补省略 to，用动词原形。

examples.en: He was seen to leave the office at six.
examples.zh: 有人看见他六点离开办公室。
examples.note: 改成被动后 to 必须还原。

examples.en: She asked me to wait, and I decided to.
examples.zh: 她让我等，我决定等。
examples.note: decided to 用 to 代替 to wait，避免重复。

examples.en: I look forward to hearing from you.
examples.zh: 我期待收到你的消息。
examples.note: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。

examples.en: He is used to working night shifts.
examples.zh: 他习惯了上夜班。
examples.note: be used to 表习惯于，to 是介词，后接动名词。

examples.en: He made her to wait outside for an hour.
examples.zh: 他让她在外面等了一个小时。
examples.note: 使役动词 make 后的宾补省略 to，应改为 made her wait。

examples.en: I am used to get up early.
examples.zh: 我习惯早起。
examples.note: 此处的 to 是介词，须接动名词，应改为 used to getting up。

pitfalls.wrong: They let him to go home early.
pitfalls.right: They let him go home early.
pitfalls.why: let 是使役动词，宾补不定式省略 to；let 本身没有被动形式，因此也不存在被动还原 to 的问题。

pitfalls.wrong: I am looking forward to see you again.
pitfalls.right: I am looking forward to seeing you again.
pitfalls.why: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，介词后必须接名词性成分，动词须变成动名词。

pitfalls.wrong: I would rather to stay at home tonight.
pitfalls.right: I would rather stay at home tonight.
pitfalls.why: would rather 后直接接动词原形，它后面不出现不定式符号 to，加了 to 反而破坏结构。

contrast.withTitle: 动名词与不定式作宾语的语义差异
contrast.diff: 本知识点只解决 to 的有无与词性；同一个动词后换形式会改意思，那属于语义差异而非 to 的取舍。

concept.mnemonic: 感官使役省 to，变被动要还；介词 to 后面一律 doing。

core: 先分 to 的词性：接原形是符号，接名词或 doing 是介词
感官与使役动词后省 to：see/make/let/have sb. do
被动语态中省去的 to 必须还原：was made to do
省略回答用 to 代替整个不定式：I decided to.
介词 to 短语：look forward to / be used to / object to + doing
review.trigger: 看到 to + 动词 → 先问 to 后面能不能放名词 → 能放就是介词，接 doing

quickCheck.q: let 后面的宾补要 to 吗？
I am used to ___ (walk) to school. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: walking，be used to 中的 to 是介词。

quickCheck.q: I decided to. 里的 to 是什么？
quickCheck.a: 代替前面出现过的整个不定式，避免重复。

drills.stem: The teacher had us ___ the poem aloud twice.
drills.answer: read
drills.explain: had 在此是使役动词 have，后接宾语 us 与省略 to 的宾补，宾补用动词原形 read。
drills.trap: to read 忽略 have 作使役动词时省 to 的规则；readed 是不存在的过去式形式。

drills.stem: I am not used to ___ (drive) on the left side of the road.
drills.answer: driving
drills.hint: be used to 表习惯于，to 是介词。
drills.explain: 先看成分：to 后缺介词宾语，缺的是名词性成分。再看关系：drive 由 I 主动发出。介词 to 后只能接动名词，与动作时间无关，故填 driving。

drills.stem: Will you join us for dinner? I would love ___.
drills.answer: to
drills.explain: would love to 后用 to 代替前面已出现的 to join us for dinner，避免重复；这是不定式的省略式。
drills.trap: to join 重复了上文内容，虽不算语法错，但在省略回答中英语一律只用 to；joining 与 would love 的搭配不符。

drills.stem: We watched the children to play in the yard.
drills.answer: We watched the children play in the yard.
accept: We watched the children play in the yard.
drills.explain: watch 是感官动词，宾补不定式省略 to，用动词原形 play；若要强调动作正在进行则用 playing，但不能用 to play。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: You may leave now if you want to.
drills.explain: want to 后用 to 代替 to leave，构成不定式的省略式；句末的 to 不能删，删掉后 want 就缺宾语。

drills.stem: 我期待在会议上见到你。
drills.answer: I look forward to meeting you at the conference.
drills.explain: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面必须接名词性成分，meet 须变为动名词 meeting；把它当不定式符号就会写成 to meet。
